months.note: per team-season equivalent = month sum x 161.7 / (2 x games in the month); boot_se = game bootstrap within the block at the point draws (no refit)

moot.note: candidates: located called pitch (no position player pitching) that is the last pitch of a PA whose feed event is a baserunning out (caught stealing, pickoff, other out). moot_same_pitch: the third out was made on that very pitch (runner playIndex = last pitch event, MLB live feed): the count was wiped on the same play, so the ball/strike call could not matter. third_out_after_the_pitch: the third out came on a later non-pitch event (pickoff between pitches) -- the call was live when made and is not moot ex ante. Statcast marks these PAs truncated_pa.

slopes.note: logit scale: logit(1 - p*) on log g (postseason.implied_slope / opt_slope.py); controls full = challenges left, inning, two strikes, three balls; no_count = without the two count indicators; none = log g only. Ranges: high = log g > -5 (top ~60 % of eligible pitches), low = log g <= -5. kappa scale (belief-map free): d kappa / d log g of the fitted criterion averaged over the eligible pitches, and OLS of kappa on log g; s_opt: signal threshold (in) at which the calibrated belief reaches the optimum's p* = D/(g + D)

lapse_state.note: lambda_side = sigmoid(llapse + llapse_low * 1{log g <= -5}); log g = -5 is the first hinge of the main criterion, at about the 40th percentile of the eligible pitches (lik.G_KNOTS). BIC with n = eligible rows.

wp_shrink.note: PA kernel pooled with a target table, weight w pitches (wp._kernel): main = all-count pooled table (T.sum(axis=0)) at w = 20. Engine, stakes g and RV recomputed; perception parameters fixed at the main fit (kappa re-evaluated at the new g); DP laws (half-inning runs) unchanged

crossfit_stakes.note: games split at random into halves A/B (seed 130 + split). Same-sample: decisions (DP pools, thresholds, calibration cells) and scoring on the stakes g of the half's own engine (PA kernel + WP engine + run laws from that half's Statcast games). Cross-fit: decisions on the other half's engine and run laws, scoring on the own-half g. Observed scored with the own-half g. Same (truth, signal) draws in both versions. bias = lost_same - lost_cross (optimism of selecting and scoring on one g)

decomp.form_note: rule s > kappa(x) + a_side + (f_side - 1) * stake_c(x) [scale] or kappa(x) + a_side - stake_c(x) + b_side * (log g - mean) [linear]; stake_c = beta_logg log g + hinges kg, centred within side over opportunities; kappa(x) at the challenges the simulated team holds (sim.kappa_by_count)
